blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **Cost per Accepted Task**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol III, Agent Economics, § Cost per Accepted Task
blocks.md: Before the team can say which model repairs tickets more cheaply, it must fix what a repair is. A configuration scored against visible tests cannot be compared with one scored against a sealed suite, however carefully the invoices are tallied, because the two denominators count different things. Acceptance is defined only under an explicitly declared contract, checker, and execution environment.

questions.q: The section **Cost per Accepted Task** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Measured cost per accepted task is the sum of every initiated task's account, each charge in exactly one category, divided by the distinct tasks accepted under one declared contract.
A one-time adaptation investment recovers its cost after N* = C_adapt / (C_base - C_adapted) tasks, never if the per-task saving is nonpositive, and only while acceptance stays equal.
Speculative decoding pays only when the accepted-draft rate shortens the output-bound critical path by more than draft and verification work add to the bill.

Ideal prefix reuse bills the quadratic re-send at the cached rate, which lowers its coefficient without removing it, so a compaction pays back only after enough turns to recover its rewrite and lost cache.

questions.explanation: This section develops **Cohort cost per accepted task**: Measured cost per accepted task is the sum of every initiated task's account, each charge in exactly one category, divided by the distinct tasks accepted under one declared contract.

questions.q: True or false: in the book's concept map, *Cohort cost per accepted task* counts only outcomes accepted under *Allocation axes*.
questions.hint: Which later concept does this idea actually connect to?
questions.explanation: False. The book links *Cohort cost per accepted task* counts only outcomes accepted under *Task acceptance contract*.

points: **Cost per accepted task**: Total cohort spending includes failed attempts and retries and is divided by distinct accepted tasks under the declared contract.
